evals.prompt: Today's day build finished. Check it before tomorrow's run.
evals.expected_output: A per-league post-run check ending in refly or ground.
expectations: Gives a row for each league (NBA, NHL, college football, college basketball) with pass or fail and numbers
Treats a league with no check result as a fail
Gives each fault a cause, a step and a named owner
Ends in refly or ground and names the release route

evals.prompt: College basketball cards came out with no projections. Just patch the NCAAM script so it does not happen tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: A shared fix, not a per-league patch, rerun for every league.
expectations: Fixes the fault in the shared pipeline or writes a reason for a league-only fix
Adds a check that would have caught the fault
Reruns every league in a copy, not only college basketball
Does not ship; routes the fix through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word

evals.prompt: Each league has its own publish script. Could they all share one pipeline?
